profile.headline: SWE @ Collins Aerospace | CS’26 @ ISU
profile.summary:
Hi! My name is Jamey, a Software Engineer at Collins Aerospace and a recent Iowa State alumn '26. I have a background in Networking, IT Infrastructure, and general Software Engineering, and am looking to utilize my experience for full-stack development or systems embedded programming.

Here are some of my technical skills, some of which I've used during my internships, namely working with Linux and Windows servers, but also;
Programming Languages: Python, Java, C, C++, and C#.
Frameworks: Langgraph and Langchain for developing agentic pipelines, .NET and React / Typescript.

I recently graduated with a BSc in Computer Science with a Data Science minor from Iowa State University in May 2026.

positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Network Services · Embedded Software

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Launching tax integration throughout Buildertrend and developing greenfield preliminary job cost prediction

Designing agent tools to develop agentic pipeline for job cost prediction in Python

Shipping C# and React / Typescript features to support tax functionality across all BT builders

positions.title: Software Engineer (Capstone)
positions.description:
Developed an agentic AI pipeline to automate insurance underwriting process from days to just 3-5 hours.

Worked on validation and authentication for security and telemetry logs for compliance.

Python AWS CDK using DynamoDB and React Typescript.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Presentation Skills

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Utilized UAV technology to collect and process multi spectral and LiDAR data with Pix4D and DJI Terra to support data insights in Agriculture Research.

Developed Python and GIS software workflows to clean, extract, and analyze large spatial datasets for data processing and automation.

positions.title: Data Management Specialist
positions.description: Skills: Data Maintenance · Business Data Management

positions.title: Information Technology Infrastructure Engineer
positions.description:
Owned 3 completed projects over a year, with 2 high-impact presentations to stakeholders and leadership.

Developed certificate management process, monitoring 100s of certificates responsible for supporting dozens of servers and applications securely and saving 10s of hours of manual work by Engineers.

Managed entire migration project of a SaaS solution, working to onboard over 80 users and their teams across the company.

Migrated obsolete network tracking tools to Zabbix, streamlining monitoring process and reduce false alerts across devices by 100 instances weekly.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Servers · Business Process Improvement · Infrastructure Technologies

positions.title: Telecommunications Engineer
positions.description:
Applied IP configurations to routers and switches via command line interface, enhancing understanding of networking infrastructure and TCP/IP model.

Developed Python scripts to automate SSH protocol for 10,000+ devices, streamlining operational efficiency.
Created Python-based tools to automate Excel spreadsheets, optimizing data management processes.

Compiled comprehensive data on company electrical substations and delivered a compelling presentation to the management team, showcasing insights and actionable information.
positions.insights: Skills: Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP) · Information Technology · Visio · Personal Responsibility · Python (Programming Language) · Problem Solving

positions.title: Student
positions.description:
At DeltaV, I developed expertise in diagnosing and resolving software and hardware issues in Linux environments, which improved my troubleshooting skills.

Created the design of an efficient I.T. process focusing on ticketing solutions, user support, and data protection in collaboration with a cross-functional team of 5 members.

Presented the devised I.T. proposal to seasoned I.T. professionals, receiving positive feedback and recognition for the proposal's effectiveness and innovation.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Information Technology · Problem Solving

positions.title: Dishwasher
positions.locationName: Cedar Rapids, Iowa, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Made sure those dishes were really clean
The boss told me on the second day of the job "he liked the way I worked"
Occassionally did some line prep work as well

projects.title: OttoNote / Netherite (Full-Stack)
projects.description: A productivity app focused on note-taking for students. Features auto-sorting of notes and folders, OCR photo scanners, voice to text and text to speech generated notes, and a lecture recorder feature designed to auto-parse notes in real time. Currently designed for Android phones. Working on porting to Web/IOS.

projects.title: Data Visualization and Storytelling
projects.description:
RUNNER-UP of ISU Ivy Business Competition!

Participated in a Data Hackathon that included analyzing over 18,000 data points of mental health and normalizing data and presented the analysis to industry professionals.
